audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart and prose disagree: full phases[2].side is 'Yorick' and content win[2] is 'Yorick', but every sentence in both layers (spikes 'Lvl 3', whys[2], early) says level 3 is Pantheon's kill window.
audit.why: Yorick's early kit is Last Rites (Q, 6s at rank 1) with no hard CC; Pantheon has Comet Spear, the Shield Vault stun and Aegis Assault by level 3. The file's own text asserts Pantheon wins level 3.
audit.corrected: Left the side values untouched — flipping a level-chart side ripples into the mirror. Flagged in questionsForUser. All prose edits keep the existing Pantheon-favoured stance at level 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never named a Yorick ability and gave no timing anchor beyond 'Maiden'.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1; Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5 — those numbers are what make 'before Maiden' actionable.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and phases[2].why now name Mourning Mist and Aegis Assault and anchor the level-3 window to real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text said 'his E-mist auto-poke' and 'his E-cage' — conflating Mourning Mist (E) with Dark Procession (W), and never naming either. The decisive interaction (Aegis Assault is invulnerable from the front, so it eats Mourning Mist and the ghoul autos that mist accelerates) was never stated.
audit.why: Mourning Mist (E, 12/11/10/9/8) is a projectile that shreds armour, slows and marks you, and summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets. Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12) is the destructible wall. Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18) makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the front.
audit.corrected: Named both abilities correctly and stated the interaction: face Aegis Assault at the marked swarm; the mist is what speeds them at you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zero cooldown-sequencing lines anywhere (packet defect confirmed: sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 and Mourning Mist 12s — the gap between them is the all-in window.
audit.corrected: early, mid, dosFull[1].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now carry explicit wait-then-commit lines with real numbers.

audit.why: Itemization already prescribes Executioner's Calling early against Last Rites healing, which is the anti-heal call flagged in _missing-interactions.json.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] ('Fight into Maiden + ghouls') carried a boilerplate description about burning a cooldown that had nothing to do with Maiden.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles buffs Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target and raises Walkers from dead enemies — the swarm is the damage source, not Yorick.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the description to state where the damage actually comes from.

edits.before: Yorick is one of the weakest pure level 1s in the game and you are one of the strongest — open with point-and-click W stun and a tapped Q for the reset and shove him off his ghoul grave-stacks. At 2 and 3 your empowered-Q poke plus the W-stun all-in flat out-trades him before Maiden exists; bait his E mist (the soul-cage slow he poke-procs with autos) by pre-loading your E block in that direction, then W in. Do not let him free-stack graves and free-farm — every wave he scales, and your whole case is winning these first three levels.
edits.after: Yorick has one of the weakest level 1s in the game and you have one of the strongest — open with the point-and-click Shield Vault stun and a tapped Comet Spear for the reset, and shove him off his grave stacks. At 2 and 3 your empowered-Q poke plus the W-stun all-in flat out-trades him before Maiden exists; Mourning Mist is the armour-shredding slow (12s at rank 1) and Dark Procession (20s) is the cage — eat the mist on Aegis Assault, then vault in while both are down. Do not let him free-stack graves — every wave he scales, and your whole case is winning these first three levels.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke and E-blocking his ghoul autos, but his sustain is stabilizing as graves and Maiden come online. At 6 your Grand Starfall is your real lever — it is built for cross-map roams, not for winning a 1v1 into Maiden, so use it to leave this side lane and snowball another lane rather than grinding a fight that gets harder every minute. Watch his E-cage: if he walls you against your tower with the ghoul swarm up, eat the trade rather than dying in it.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke and Aegis Assault soaking ghoul autos, but his sustain stabilizes as graves and Maiden come online. At 6 your Grand Starfall is your real lever — it is built for cross-map roams, not for winning a 1v1 into Maiden, so use it to leave this side lane and snowball another rather than grinding a fight that gets harder every minute. Watch Dark Procession (16s at rank 3): if he walls you against your tower with the swarm up, eat the trade rather than dying in it.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
